approaches_tried.approach: Treat the first gate8 FAIL as caused by my own concurrent test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh invocation
approaches_tried.reason: Re-ran gate8 cleanly (no concurrent interference, verified via process-table checks) and it STILL reported FAIL. Had to dig further: direct byte-for-byte reproduction of gate8_run's own run-all.sh invocation line (with and without GATE_MUTEX_HELD=1) consistently returns exit 0 with the identical EXPECTED-only roster, so the discrepancy is internal to verify-deploy.sh's gate8_run wrapper itself, not caused by concurrent interference or by this task's edits.

Discharged this phase's verification against the directive's named scoped narrowing instead (verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 8), plus direct standalone suite runs covering every file this phase touched.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: deferred to batch stage per Batch Gate Deferral directive)*

deviations.reason: Not named in the plan's own task list. Fixing the ROOT resolution in Phase 2 unmasked a SECOND, independently pre-existing defect: case11 perturbed $CORE_DIR/lib (invocation-path dependent) to test implementation-digest sensitivity, but gate_cache_implementation_digest's own component-3 resolution (gate_cache_libdir_digest) is source-store-first/deployed-fallback, identical to other resolvers in the same library -- so perturbing the deployed lib copy from the deployed invocation path never touched what the digest actually hashes. Fixed by having the test resolve the SAME directory the SUT resolves before picking a file to perturb. This is squarely within the plan's own stated Goal ('every one of the five named suites passes from both invocation paths') and was required to meet Phase 6's own verification bar, so it was completed rather than deferred, though it required re-running deploy-headless.sh a second time.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- an additional, previously-masked defect in test-gate-cache-lib.sh case11 was found and fixed, beyond the plan's named root-computation edit)*

This is a pre-existing discrepancy in verify-deploy.sh's gate8_run function, a file this task did not edit and a mechanism unrelated to repo-root path resolution. Left for a separate task; recorded via issue-record.sh with full reproduction detail.
